title: Revenue from Contracts with Customers
intro: IFRS 15 = **5 خطوات**: العقد ← التزامات الأداء ← سعر المعاملة ← التوزيع ← الاعتراف بالإيراد.
الإيراد يُعترف به لما **السيطرة** تنتقل للعميل: على مدى زمني أو عند نقطة زمنية.

tf.s: Revenue is recognised when control of goods or services passes to the customer.
Variable consideration is included only to the extent a significant reversal is highly probable not to occur.
The transaction price is allocated based on each obligation's profit margin.
tf.why: It is allocated on relative stand-alone selling prices.

tf.s: A contract liability arises when the customer pays before the entity performs.
Incremental costs of obtaining a contract are always expensed.
tf.why: They are capitalised if expected to be recovered (practical expedient for 1 year or less).

fill.s: Step 1 is to identify the ___ with a customer.
The transaction price is allocated on relative stand-alone selling ___.
Revenue is recognised when the customer obtains ___ of the asset.
A promise to transfer a distinct good or service is a performance ___.

source: Written for IFRS Play from the standard's core requirements. Exact source reference could not be verified from the uploaded document.

je.s: A customer pays 30,000 in advance for goods to be delivered next month.
je.why: No performance yet, so a contract liability.

je.s: The goods are now delivered (the 30,000 advance was received last month).
je.why: Control passes on delivery: release the contract liability to revenue.

calc.s: A phone plus a 2-year service plan sells for 1,200. Stand-alone prices: phone 900, service 600. Revenue allocated to the phone?
Contract price 1,000,000. Costs to date 300,000; total expected costs 750,000 (input method). Revenue to date?

steps: Allocate the price to the obligations
Recognise revenue when obligations are satisfied
